content.description: Add the CSRF token to the form by including `{% csrf_token %}` within the form tags. This ensures that the form is protected against CSRF attacks by validating the origin of the request. Refer to OWASP CSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Cross-Site_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html).

example.after:
Before:
<form method="post">
    <!-- form fields -->
</form>

After:
<form method="post">
    {% csrf_token %}
    <!-- form fields -->
</form>
